questions.question: In 1951, the first Asian Games was held in which city?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **New Delhi** was the host city for the first Asian Games held in 1951.
 
• The Asian Games, also known as the Asiad, is a continental multi-sport event held every four years among athletes from all over Asia.
 
• The event is organized by the Asian Games Federation (AGF) and is recognized by the International Olympic Committee (IOC).
 
• The first Asian Games took place from March 4 to March 11, 1951.
 
• A total of 489 athletes from 11 National Olympic Committees participated in the event.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Asian Games were initiated to foster unity and cooperation among Asian countries post World War II.
 
• The 1951 Asian Games featured six sports: athletics, aquatics (swimming and diving), basketball, cycling, football, and weightlifting.
 
• India finished second in the medal tally, winning a total of 51 medals, including 15 golds.
 
• Japan topped the medal tally, securing 60 medals, including 24 golds.
 
• The success of the first Asian Games set the stage for future editions, with the event growing in scale and participation over the decades.

questions.question: What is a government budget?

options.text: A report on the economic growth of a country.
A plan for managing personal finances.
A financial statement of a government's expected revenue and expenditure for a specific period.
A document outlining foreign policy goals.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A government budget is a **financial statement of a government's expected revenue and expenditure for a specific period**, usually a fiscal year.
 
• The budget outlines the government's financial plans, including how it intends to allocate resources to various sectors such as defense, education, healthcare, and infrastructure.
 
• It serves as a tool for economic policy, allowing the government to manage the economy by controlling public spending and taxation.
 
• The budget also includes proposals for new taxes or changes to existing tax rates, as well as plans for borrowing and debt management.
 
• It reflects the government's priorities and is a key document for ensuring transparency and accountability in public finance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The government budget is typically presented annually in the parliament or legislative assembly by the finance minister.
 
• It is subject to debate and approval by the legislative body before being implemented.
 
• The budget process involves several stages, including proposal, review, approval, implementation, and evaluation.
 
• Effective budgeting is crucial for maintaining fiscal discipline and achieving sustainable economic growth.
 
• Governments around the world use budgets to plan for both short-term and long-term financial goals.

• The Mediterranean region is known for its unique climate, characterized by hot, dry summers and mild, wet winters.
 
• Several important ancient civilizations, including the Egyptians, Phoenicians, Greeks, and Romans, flourished around the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.question: The word Kathak is derived from the Sanskrit word Katha, which means:
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Story**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'kathak'** is derived from the Sanskrit word **'katha'**, which means **story**__.
 
• **Kathak** is a classical dance form that originated in Northern India and is characterized by intricate footwork, spins, and expressive gestures.
 
• Historically, **Kathak** dancers, known as **kathakars** or storytellers, would narrate stories from epics and mythology through dance.
 
• The dance form has evolved over centuries and now incorporates elements of both Hindu and Persian cultures.
 
• **Kathak** is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The **word 'kathak'** comes from the tradition of **storytellers** or **kathakars** who would recount tales from the great epics and ancient scriptures.
 
• **Kathak** has three main gharanas (schools) - **Lucknow, Jaipur, and Banaras**, each with its own unique style and emphasis.
 
• It is performed to the accompaniment of classical music, with instruments such as the **tabla** and **harmonium** being central to the performance.
 
• The dance form also includes the use of **ghungroos** (bells) tied around the ankles, which add rhythmic complexity to the performance.

questions.question: In relation to the state of Tamil Nadu, the Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Act, 2022 will include the __________ and Kurivikkaran communities in the list of Scheduled Tribes in Tamil Nadu.

• The Constitution (Scheduled Tribes) Order (Second Amendment) Act, 2022 includes the **Narikoravan** and Kurivikkaran communities in the list of Scheduled Tribes in Tamil Nadu.

• The President of India, in consultation with the Governor of the respective state, is empowered to specify the tribes or tribal communities to be included in the list of Scheduled Tribes.
 
• Periodic amendments are made to the list to include or exclude communities based on socio-economic criteria and recommendations from state governments and other stakeholders.
 
• The inclusion of a community in the Scheduled Tribes list allows its members to avail various constitutional safeguards and welfare measures aimed at their socio-economic upliftment.

questions.question: Which antibiotic is considered the first miracle drug, used to treat throat infections, meningitis, syphilis and other bacterial infections?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Penicillin**__

__
 
• **Penicillin** is considered the first miracle drug.
 
• It was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928 and became widely used in the 1940s.
 
• Penicillin is effective against a wide range of bacterial infections, including throat infections, meningitis, and syphilis.
 
• Its discovery marked the beginning of modern antibiotics and has saved countless lives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Penicillin** works by interfering with the ability of bacteria to form cell walls, leading to their destruction.
 
• It was first mass-produced during World War II, playing a critical role in treating infections among soldiers.
 
• Penicillin has led to the development of other antibiotics, transforming medical treatment of bacterial infections.
 
• Despite its effectiveness, some bacteria have developed resistance to penicillin, highlighting the need for ongoing research in antibiotic development.

questions.question: Which physicist's experiment during a lecture in 1820 showed the connection between electricity and magnetism?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Hans Christian Oersted**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hans Christian Oersted** was a Danish physicist and chemist.
 
• In 1820, during a lecture, he discovered that a compass needle is deflected by a nearby electric current, demonstrating a direct relationship between electricity and magnetism.
 
• This experiment laid the groundwork for the field of electromagnetism.
 
• Oersted's discovery showed that electric currents create magnetic fields, which was a major milestone in the study of physics.
 
• This connection between electricity and magnetism is fundamental to many modern technologies, including electric motors and transformers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hans Christian Oersted** was born on August 14, 1777, and died on March 9, 1851.
 
• He was also the first to isolate aluminum in 1825.
 
• Oersted's work influenced later scientists, including André-Marie Ampère, who further developed the theory of electromagnetism.
 
• The unit of magnetic field strength in the CGS system, the oersted (Oe), is named in his honor.

questions.question: Which state of India is associated with the famous thunderstorms ‘Kaal Baisakhi’?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kaal Baisakhi** is a local name for pre-monsoon thunderstorms in India, especially prevalent in the state of **West Bengal**.
 
• These thunderstorms typically occur during the months of March to May and are known for their sudden and intense nature.
 
• They bring heavy rainfall, strong winds, and occasionally hail, which can cause significant damage to crops and property.
 
• Kaal Baisakhi is a significant weather phenomenon for farmers in West Bengal as it provides much-needed rainfall for the cultivation of crops like jute and rice.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• These storms are also known as **Nor'westers** due to the direction from which they typically originate.
 
• The phenomenon is not limited to West Bengal but also affects other regions in the eastern part of India, including Assam and Bihar.
 
• Despite their destructive potential, Kaal Baisakhi thunderstorms are crucial for recharging groundwater levels and providing relief from the intense heat of the pre-monsoon season.
 
• The term "Kaal Baisakhi" translates to "Calamity of Baisakh," with Baisakh being a month in the Bengali calendar.
